first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: A white goose with a long, slender neck, an orange beak, and orange webbed feet, continuously carrying Object A.

entities.name: Object A
entities.identification: The light-yellow rounded block-shaped package in front of Animal A's beak, with a blue stripe and two dark circular markings.

entities.name: gray street surface
entities.identification: The broad, flat gray street surface on which Animal A is located.

entities.name: red-cloth market table
entities.identification: A brown rectangular wooden table covered with a red cloth with white wavy trim.

entities.name: stack of light-colored blocks with blue patterns
entities.identification: Light-yellow packages neatly stacked beside the table, with blue markings on the sides and multiple rows of dark circular markings on the top surface.

entities.name: brown A-frame sign
entities.identification: A standing sign with a wide brown frame, a dark rectangular sign face, and front and rear support legs spread apart.

entities.name: dark-gray tiled roof
entities.identification: The dark-gray sloped roof surface along the bottom edge of the image, with rows of staggered tiles on its surface.

entities.name: rooftop chimney
entities.identification: The chimney structure on the foreground roof, with a gray square cap and two brown curved-top flue pipes overlapping front to back visible.

entities.name: green median grass
entities.identification: The flat green grass area in the upper left, separated by a light-colored curb and only partially in frame.

entities.name: wooden bench
entities.identification: The bench within the green median grass, with parts of its brown backrest, seat board, and black supports visible.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A plant cart with a red tubular frame, a long black box-shaped trough, and black circular wheels with red hubs.

entities.name: black box-bin
entities.identification: The dark square container to the image-left of Vehicle A, with a thick frame, crossbars, and a dark-blue interior surface.

entities.name: small light-blue seat-surface object
entities.identification: The small light-blue object at the end of the wooden bench's seat board, partially showing an angular outline and partly cropped by the left edge.

entities.name: light-colored curb
entities.identification: The narrow beige-gray boundary strip between the grass and the street surface, with seams and an angled corner partially visible.

entities.name: group of green plants
entities.identification: The green upright tall stems and leaves and the lighter-colored low clump of leaves in Vehicle A's box-shaped trough.

entities.name: blue merchandise pallet
entities.identification: Three shallow blue rectangular trays arranged side by side horizontally on the red-cloth market table, with colored objects in the trays and along their front edges.

entities.name: red display rack
entities.identification: The partially visible red vertical backboard and forward-projecting shelf structure behind the red-cloth market table.

entities.name: thin gray upright pole
entities.identification: The straight, slender gray pole within the green median grass, with its upper end extending out of frame.
